checks.name: W01 setup admin, create analyst and reviewer
W02 the gateway reports its provider chain
W03 research panel: automatic research on the Binance case
W04 import the proposed cards into the inbox
W05 manual route: build the prompt, paste a Claude answer, import
W06 presence: two analysts on the same case see each other; editing a card shows a soft lock
W07 concurrent edits on the same case are merged, not overwritten
W08 @mention in a comment notifies the named analyst
W09 history tab lists revisions and restores one

checks.detail: rejected: TLP:RED files need a second account to publish (you sent it for review)

shots.title: W01 · AI research: start
shots.caption: The ◆ AI research panel on the board. Type what to research (the case title is pre-filled), choose sources, optionally paste URLs, and keep "use case notes as context" on so the model knows what the case already says. Sources without a server key are greyed out.
marks: Manual route: prompt for Claude, paste the answer

shots.title: W02 · AI research: proposed cards
shots.caption: Results: a summary, the sources that were gathered and read, and proposed cards grouped by type with a confidence per card and the source it came from. Low-confidence cards start unticked. Every card keeps its source, URL, collection date and Admiralty grade.
marks: Counts and the engine that extracted (rule engine here; a model when a key is set)

shots.title: W03 · AI research: imported
shots.caption: After import: the cards wait in the evidence inbox with their source and grade, plus a "Research:" document holding the summary and the source list. Pin what holds up; delete what does not. The case log records the import.
marks: Imported research cards in the inbox

shots.title: W04 · AI research: prompt for Claude, paste the answer
shots.caption: The manual route when the server has no model key or you prefer Claude in the app: step 1 gathers sources and copies a complete prompt (instructions, case context, what is already on the board, the sources, the exact JSON shape); step 2 you run it in Claude; step 3 paste the JSON answer and it is validated into the same review table.

shots.title: W05 · Presence and soft locks
shots.caption: Presence: the strip at the top shows who else is on this case and which exhibit they are looking at; a pencil means they are typing in it. Selecting the same card shows a soft-lock notice. Edits are not blocked: concurrent saves are merged field by field on the server.
marks: Who is here, and what they are on
Soft lock: someone is editing this card

shots.title: W06 · Notifications
shots.caption: Activity drawer (◆ bottom right): mentions (@name in a comment), review requests, overdue tasks and watcher alerts, pushed live from the server. Click one to jump to the case and card. The History tab lists server revisions; Review sends the file to a reviewer.
marks: Activity button with the unread count

shots.title: W07 · Revision history
shots.caption: History: every save by anyone is a server revision (who, when, size). Restore puts the board back to that revision and keeps the current state in the history, so nothing is lost.

shots.title: W08 · Request review
shots.caption: Review tab: pick a reviewer and send the file for review. The reviewer is notified. For TLP:RED and AMBER+STRICT files the server refuses to let the same account that requested review also publish it.
